Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 113. Category: feat. Chronin Feats.

Your storage speed is even faster then before. You gain
the option to turn Stamina into Time Points as a bonus
action.
This feat can be taken a second time to gain the
option to do this as a reaction. Taking this feat does not
remove your ability to store time points as an action or
bonus action if you have that capability already.
